Strict adherence to user specifications:
- Device context: Player tablet, landscape 1180x820, zero scroll.
- Aesthetic: Brutal Diegetic Console, dark cyberpunk palette (bg #070d1f, surface #0c1324 / #151b2d, border #1e293b, accent cyan #06b6d4 / #22d3ee, text #f8fafc, text-muted #898c95, danger #ef4444, warning #f59e0b). 0px border-radius everywhere.
- Header (top bar): Left side: "■ GM-OS // JOUEUR" and operation title "OPÉRATION EN COURS : LE SILENCE DE VARN". Right side: network state "■ ● CONNECTÉ" (green dot, verified connected) and a single toggle button "⚡ MODE PERFORMANCE" (height >= 44px). No PC GM sidebar, no PC GM header toolbar.
- Compact telemetry sub-header / bar:
  - Horloge: "23:37:05" in Space Mono bold, "Dimanche 4 octobre 2026", "TABLE".
  - Tension publique: "ALERTE DE LA STATION" (readable in full), "3/8", with tactile segmented gauge (3 active segments in warning amber/orange, 5 inactive).
- Inventory section (wide central zone):
  - Heading: "INVENTAIRE" in Orbitron display bold, sub-label "Trésors, reliques et possessions personnelles.", counter badge "1 OBJETS" (cyan/outline).
  - Category header: "SAC À DOS (INTERACTIF)" without "CONTENANT #01" (expressly removed per instructions).
  - No search bar, no filters, no sorting dropdown, no weight/capacity counters, no decorative diagnostic widgets.
  - The Single Item Card:
    - Title: "OUTIL MULTIFONCTION" readable in full (no truncation).
    - Quantity badge: "x1" in Space Mono.
    - Tag: "COMMON" badge (Inter 11px uppercase).
    - Description: "Pour ouvrir le relais." (Inter 14px, readable).
    - Icon: 3D cube / tech tool wireframe vector.
    - Two large distinct touch action buttons (height >= 44px, targets >= 44x44px):
      1. "⇄ Donner" (cyan button / accent touch)
      2. "🗑 Jeter" (danger button with red outline/text)
    - Both "Donner" and "Jeter" are completely visible and accessible, never hidden.
- Transfer Overlay Modal ("Donner"):
  - When clicking or viewing the transfer modal/sheet: "TRANSFÉRER L'OBJET // OUTIL MULTIFONCTION (x1)".
  - Two eligible recipients from the party:
    1. "Idris Koa" — "Négociateur"
    2. "Sora Adebayo" — "Médecin de bord"
  - Explanatory validation note: "Avertissement : Le transfert sera soumis à la validation du Meneur de Jeu avant synchronisation."
  - Action buttons: "CONFIRMER LE TRANSFERT" (accent cyan, >=44px) and "ANNULER" (>=44px).
  - No quantity selector (only x1), no added buttons.
- Bottom Navigation Bar (complete 10 destinations in two docked rows, all targets >= 44x44px):
  - Row 1 (6 primary views):
    - "DIRECT"
    - "ARCHIVES"
    - "PNJ"
    - "LIEUX"
    - "INVENTAIRE ●" (Active state: bold cyan background #06b6d4, text #070d1f)
    - "CARTES"
  - Row 2 (4 secondary views):
    - "◆ FICHE"
    - "✎ NOTES"
    - "✉ MESSAGES" (written out in full "MESSAGES", not truncated to msgs)
    - "⏹ QUITTER" (tactile button with confirmation prompt, not a simple raw alert)
- Zero PC GM elements (no GM sidebar, no audio mixer, no dice roller).
- Strict typography: Orbitron for headers, Space Mono for digits/clocks/counters, Inter for text (all text >= 14px, all labels/badges >= 11px). All interactive targets >= 44x44px. All text in French. Brutal Diegetic Console","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system embodies a hard-edged, utilitarian, diegetic console aesthetic inspired by high-readability telemetry terminals, tactical interfaces, and deep-space mission operating systems. The visual tone is technical, calculating, and immersive—evoking extreme operational precision, situational awareness, and robust reliability under pressure.

The style fuses **Brutalism** with **Modern Sci-Fi Ergonomics**. Interfaces rely on crisp structural boundaries, high-contrast monospace readouts, visible panel seams, and deep obsidian-to-slate container layers punctuated by surgical hits of vivid cyan. Typography prioritizes immediate scanability and dense data telemetry, eschewing ornamental fluff in favor of strict diagnostic clarity and tactical utility.

## Layout & Spacing

Layout follows a strict, modular chassis grid with dense information packing:

- **Desktop (1024px+)**: 12-column rigid grid with `1.5rem` gutters and `2rem` screen margins. Interfaces favor split-panel layouts, persistent status rails, and multi-pane telemetry readouts.
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px)**: 8-column layout with `1rem` gutters. Sidebars fold into high-density top instrument bars.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: 4-column layout with `1rem` margins and `1rem` gutters. Layouts flow into vertically stacked operational modules.

Component margins and paddings adhere strictly to the 4px / 8px incremental scale (`space-xs` through `space-xl`), eliminating loose or ambiguous whitespace.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy does not use diffuse blurs, soft drop shadows, or skeuomorphic bevels. Instead, elevation is produced entirely through:

1. **Tonal Planar Stepping**: Moving forward in z-index transitions the element background from `background` (`#020617`) to `surface-container-lowest` (`#070d1f`), through `surface-container` (`#192031`), up to `surface-bright` (`#33394c`) for floating HUD overlays.
2. **Crisp Structural Seams (Low-Contrast & Bold Outlines)**: Panels are enclosed with sharp 1px borders using `outline` (`#1e293b`) or `outline-variant` (`#151b2d`). Active or focused elements switch to a hard 1px border of `primary` (`#06b6d4`).
3. **Diegetic Glare / Terminal Accents**: Focused surfaces or alerts may leverage a hard, un-blurred outer hairline offset or subtle 1px border glow in `#06b6d4`, signaling an energized active circuit.

## Components

- **Buttons**:
  - *Primary*: Background `#06b6d4`, text `#020617` (bold `label-sm`), 0px border radius, uppercase typography with tracking. Hover state shifts to `#9bf0ff`.
  - *Secondary / Ghost*: Background `surface-container`, 1px solid `outline` (`#1e293b`), text `on-surface` (`#dee2f7`). Hover state activates a 1px border of `primary` (`#06b6d4`).
  - *Critical*: Background `error-container` (`#93000a`), 1px solid `error` (`#ef4444`), text `#ffdad6`.

- **Input Fields**:
  - Boxy, flat containers with `surface-container-lowest` fills and 1px `outline` borders. Text uses `body-md` in `on-surface`, with placeholder text in `on-surface-variant`.
  - Focused state triggers an immediate 1px solid `#06b6d4` perimeter highlight without drop-shadow glow.

- **Chips & Status Tags**:
  - Ultra-compact, sharp badges with `0.25rem` vertical and `0.5rem` horizontal padding.
  - Background `surface-container-high` with uppercase `label-sm` font. Telemetry indicators prepend a 6px square glyph (e.g., solid cyan for active, crimson for alert).

- **Cards & Diagnostic Panels**:
  - Built with `surface-container-low` or `surface-container` backgrounds framed by 1px `outline` strokes.
  - Headers feature an uppercase title bar in `label-sm` or `headline-sm`, separated from body content by a continuous 1px divider rule in `outline-variant`.

- **Checkboxes & Toggle Switches**:
  - Checkboxes are strict square frames (16x16px) with an un-rounded 1px border; checked state shows a solid square block of `#06b6d4` in the center.
  - Toggles use stepped rectangular sliding brackets rather than pill shapes.

px)** (`GM-OS — Tablette Joueur : Inventaire (Tablette Paysage 1180×820)`), créée en respectant scrupuleusement le gabarit de l'écran mobile d'origine et toutes vos consignes d'ergonomie et de fidélité :

---

### 📐 1. Agencement Paysage & Exploitation de l'Espace (1180 × 820 px)
- **Format Zero-Scroll :** L'intégralité des sections (en-tête joueur, sous-bandeau de télémesure compact, conteneur large de l'inventaire et navigation complète en pied) tient dans la hauteur de 820 px sans défilement vertical.
- **En-tête Joueur épuré :**
  - Identité à gauche : `■ GM-OS // JOUEUR` et surtitre d'opération `OPÉRATION EN COURS : LE SILENCE DE VARN`.
  - Statut à droite : État réseau officiel **`■ ● CONNECTÉ`** en vert et bouton tactile unique **`⚡ MODE PERFORMANCE`** (hauteur $\ge 44$ px).
  - Absence stricte de barre latérale ou de bandeau de régie PC du meneur.

---

### ⏱️ 2. Télémesure Compacte (Horloge & Tension)
- **Horloge :** Affichage compact de l'heure **`23:37:05`** en Space Mono avec la date complète `Dimanche 4 octobre 2026` et la pastille `TABLE`.
- **Tension Publique :** Libellé officiel complet et lisible sans troncature **`ALERTE DE LA STATION`**, valeur **`3/8`** et rail segmenté avec 3 crans en ambre d'alerte.

---

### 🎒 3. Zone Centrale : Inventaire & Objet Unique
- **Titre & Compteur :** Grand titre `INVENTAIRE` en Orbitron, sous-titre `Trésors, reliques et possessions personnelles.` et badge `1 OBJETS`.
- **Section Sac à dos :** Intitulé épuré `SAC À DOS (INTERACTIF)` sans aucune mention parasite (suppression formelle de `CONTENANT #01`).
- **Absence totale de fonctions superflues :** Pas de barre de recherche, pas de filtre, pas de tri, pas de calcul de poids total, ni de faux diagnostics décoratifs.
- **Carte unique de l'objet :**
  - **Titre complet :** **`OUTIL MULTIFONCTION`** (affiché en entier, en graisse accentuée).
  - **Quantité & Rareté :** Badge `x1` en Space Mono et tag `COMMON` ($\ge 11$ px).
  - **Description :** *« Pour ouvrir le relais. »* (texte en Inter à 14 px).
  - **Icône diégétique :** Repère filaire isométrique technique.
  - **Les Deux Actions Tactiles :**
    - **`⇄ DONNER`** : Bouton plein d'accent cyan ($\ge 44 \times 44$ px) qui ouvre la surcouche de transfert.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system embodies a hard-edged, utilitarian, diegetic console aesthetic inspired by high-readability telemetry terminals, tactical interfaces, and deep-space mission operating systems. The visual tone is technical, calculating, and immersive—evoking extreme operational precision, situational awareness, and robust reliability under pressure.

The style fuses **Brutalism** with **Modern Sci-Fi Ergonomics**. Interfaces rely on crisp structural boundaries, high-contrast monospace readouts, visible panel seams, and deep obsidian-to-slate container layers punctuated by surgical hits of vivid cyan. Typography prioritizes immediate scanability and dense data telemetry, eschewing ornamental fluff in favor of strict diagnostic clarity and tactical utility.

## Layout & Spacing

Layout follows a strict, modular chassis grid with dense information packing:

- **Desktop (1024px+)**: 12-column rigid grid with `1.5rem` gutters and `2rem` screen margins. Interfaces favor split-panel layouts, persistent status rails, and multi-pane telemetry readouts.
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px)**: 8-column layout with `1rem` gutters. Sidebars fold into high-density top instrument bars.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: 4-column layout with `1rem` margins and `1rem` gutters. Layouts flow into vertically stacked operational modules.

Component margins and paddings adhere strictly to the 4px / 8px incremental scale (`space-xs` through `space-xl`), eliminating loose or ambiguous whitespace.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy does not use diffuse blurs, soft drop shadows, or skeuomorphic bevels. Instead, elevation is produced entirely through:

1. **Tonal Planar Stepping**: Moving forward in z-index transitions the element background from `background` (`#020617`) to `surface-container-lowest` (`#070d1f`), through `surface-container` (`#192031`), up to `surface-bright` (`#33394c`) for floating HUD overlays.
2. **Crisp Structural Seams (Low-Contrast & Bold Outlines)**: Panels are enclosed with sharp 1px borders using `outline` (`#1e293b`) or `outline-variant` (`#151b2d`). Active or focused elements switch to a hard 1px border of `primary` (`#06b6d4`).
3. **Diegetic Glare / Terminal Accents**: Focused surfaces or alerts may leverage a hard, un-blurred outer hairline offset or subtle 1px border glow in `#06b6d4`, signaling an energized active circuit.

## Components

- **Buttons**:
  - *Primary*: Background `#06b6d4`, text `#020617` (bold `label-sm`), 0px border radius, uppercase typography with tracking. Hover state shifts to `#9bf0ff`.
  - *Secondary / Ghost*: Background `surface-container`, 1px solid `outline` (`#1e293b`), text `on-surface` (`#dee2f7`). Hover state activates a 1px border of `primary` (`#06b6d4`).
  - *Critical*: Background `error-container` (`#93000a`), 1px solid `error` (`#ef4444`), text `#ffdad6`.

- **Input Fields**:
  - Boxy, flat containers with `surface-container-lowest` fills and 1px `outline` borders. Text uses `body-md` in `on-surface`, with placeholder text in `on-surface-variant`.
  - Focused state triggers an immediate 1px solid `#06b6d4` perimeter highlight without drop-shadow glow.

- **Chips & Status Tags**:
  - Ultra-compact, sharp badges with `0.25rem` vertical and `0.5rem` horizontal padding.
  - Background `surface-container-high` with uppercase `label-sm` font. Telemetry indicators prepend a 6px square glyph (e.g., solid cyan for active, crimson for alert).

- **Cards & Diagnostic Panels**:
  - Built with `surface-container-low` or `surface-container` backgrounds framed by 1px `outline` strokes.
  - Headers feature an uppercase title bar in `label-sm` or `headline-sm`, separated from body content by a continuous 1px divider rule in `outline-variant`.

- **Checkboxes & Toggle Switches**:
  - Checkboxes are strict square frames (16x16px) with an un-rounded 1px border; checked state shows a solid square block of `#06b6d4` in the center.
  - Toggles use stepped rectangular sliding brackets rather than pill shapes.

- **Data Readout Cells**:
  - Dedicated telemetry components consisting of an uppercase `label-sm` identifier in `on-surface-variant` stacked above a dominant `code-lg` value in `#06b6d4` or `on-surface`.

  - Horloge: "23:37:05" in Space Mono bold, "Dimanche 4 octobre 2026", "TABLE".

  - Heading: "INVENTAIRE" in Orbitron display bold, sub-label "Trésors, reliques et possessions personnelles.", counter badge "1 OBJETS" (cyan/outline).

  - No search bar, no filters, no sorting dropdown, no weight/capacity counters, no decorative diagnostic widgets.
  - The Single Item Card:
    - Title: "OUTIL MULTIFONCTION" readable in full (no truncation).

    - Tag: "COMMON" badge (Inter 11px uppercase).
    - Description: "Pour ouvrir le relais." (Inter 14px, readable).
    - Icon: 3D cube / tech tool wireframe vector.

  - Action buttons: "CONFIRMER LE TRANSFERT" (accent cyan, >=44px) and "ANNULER" (>=44px).

    - "⏹ QUITTER" (tactile button with confirmation prompt, not a simple raw alert)

- Strict typography: Orbitron for headers, Space Mono for digits/clocks/counters, Inter for text (all text >= 14px, all labels/badges >= 11px). All interactive targets >= 44x44px. All text in French. Fully responsive fluid 1180x820 container.
